title: A new Star Wars racing game has people reconsidering a nine year old's driving
dek: An account with 91 followers quoted a gameplay clip and collected 42,000 likes for one observation about Anakin Skywalker.
what: Star Wars: Galactic Racer, from the studio Fuse Games, came out on 6 October. Two days later a post quoting a clip of it said that playing the game puts into perspective how extraordinary it was that Anakin was podracing at nine. It has more than half a million views.
why: It is a joke that doubles as a review of the game.

sources.label: Secret Mode: Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches on October 6th
